name: NeoFreeBird
subtitle: A modified Twitter app with BHTwitter and other QoL modifications.

versions.localizedDescription:
New Features
- Added a “Download all Videos” button (only works when all media items are videos)
- Added option to see quote and retweet numbers (with an option for unrounded counts)
- Added an option to play a custom sound (under 7 seconds and with the AAC format) when a tweet is posted
- Hide the “Download Grok Bot” button on Grok Tweets
- NeoFreeBird now has (preliminary!) support for MacOS!

Fixes
- Fixed Spaces not loading
- Fixed all web views not loading (including Community Notes, reports, and web replying)
- Fixed the header switching back to black from dim on iPad
- Fixed mute settings not loading
- Fixed ads showing up in the Tiktok-like video feed
- Fixed verified tweets not showing up in searches and edit histories when the “Hide verified tweets” option was on
- Removed the “Edit Tweet” prompt showing up, this has been server-side for a while
- Removed tweet source labels from the codebase, as X has removed it from all API calls
- Fixed manual Grok Translate calls

Known Issues
- The option to see quote and retweet numbers is not localized. Most likely will be fixed in the next version.

- Added option to hide Message button on tweets
- Updated X to 12.28.1
- Removed the “Try Grok Bot” button
- Added new login flow
